notes.title: Update 0.006
notes.content:
Current update version is 0.006. There will be many more updates, hopefully at least one per week. There is a brand new level 3 (Ranch) in this current update. In next update there will be many more enemies, plus new evidence, like money, etc..

There will be also a story in this game, but not so soon, probably when game comes out of early access. Thank you for your support and keep us updated for bugs. We will do our best, that there will be many big updates.
